title: Phrasal verbs
note: Rewrite 2026-08-30 from Spec_Phrasal-Verbs_B1_G_PP, then four-type intro (James smoke). Closed bank of 12 + intro exemplars set off / get on with. Check is sort into four types. Quiz 12 · Type 12 · Use 12 (one item per bank verb). Dual Codex G_PP-B1B2-01.
use_hint: Fix the sentence · Enter = check · Enter = next

rows: a group of words that belong together
a verb of more than one word (**multi-word verb**)

cards.title: Twelve useful phrasal verbs
points: Learn each one as a whole.

cards.title: No object
points: No object — the meaning is already complete.

cards.title: Object, separable

rows: turn **on** the TV ✓ · turn the TV **on** ✓

points: Pronouns **must** go between verb and particle.

cards.title: Object, inseparable
points: The object always stays after the particle.

cards.title: Two particles

rows: get **on** with the work ✓ · ~~get the work **on** with~~

points: Two small words. Keep them together.

items.en: It's dark. Please turn on the light.
items.gap: It's dark. Please turn ____ the light. (start)
items.explanation: Dark → start the light: turn **on**. Not **off**.
items.explanation_cz: Tma → rozsvítit: turn **on**. Ne **off**.

items.en: I want to sleep. Please turn off the light.
items.gap: I want to sleep. Please turn ____ the light. (stop)
items.explanation: Sleep → stop the light: turn **off**. Not **on**.
items.explanation_cz: Spánek → zhasnout: turn **off**. Ne **on**.

items.en: I need to pick up my daughter from school at three.
items.cz: Musím vyzvednout dceru ze školy ve tři.
items.gap: I need to pick ____ my daughter from school at three. (collect)
items.explanation: **pick up** = collect someone. **in / off / out** do not mean that here.
items.explanation_cz: **pick up** = vyzvednout. **in / off / out** tady neznamenají to samé.

items.en: We had to put off the meeting.
items.gap: We had to put ____ the meeting. (postpone)
items.explanation: **put off** = postpone. **put up / on / away** are real, but not postpone.
items.explanation_cz: **put off** = odložit. **put up / on / away** existují, ale neznamenají odložit.

items.en: He gave up smoking two years ago.
items.gap: He gave ____ smoking two years ago. (quit)
items.explanation: **give up** = quit. **give in / off / out** are real, but not quit smoking.
items.explanation_cz: **give up** = přestat. **give in / off / out** existují, ale neznamenají přestat kouřit.

items.explanation: **fill in** = complete a form. Not **on / up / off**.
items.explanation_cz: **fill in** = vyplnit formulář. Ne **on / up / off**.

items.en: Can you find out what time it starts?
items.cz: Můžeš zjistit, v kolik to začíná?
items.gap: Can you find ____ what time it starts? (discover)
items.explanation: **find out** = discover information. Not **find in / up / off**.
items.explanation_cz: **find out** = zjistit. Ne **find in / up / off**.

items.explanation: **set off** = leave. No object. Not **set on / up / in**.
items.explanation_cz: **set off** = vyrazit. Bez předmětu. Ne **set on / up / in**.

items.en: Nurses look after sick people in hospital.
items.cz: Sestry se starají o nemocné v nemocnici.
items.gap: Nurses look ____ sick people in hospital. (care)
items.explanation: **look after** = take care of. Not look **for** (search — a preposition).
items.explanation_cz: **look after** = starat se. Ne look **for** (hledat — předložka).

items.en: Carry on with your work — don't stop because of me.
items.cz: Pokračuj v práci — kvůli mně se nezastavuj.
items.gap: Carry ____ with your work — don't stop because of me. (continue)
items.explanation: **carry on** = continue. **carry out / off / up** do not mean continue here.
items.explanation_cz: **carry on** = pokračovat. **carry out / off / up** tady neznamenají pokračovat.

items.explanation: **come back** = return. **come in / out / up** are real, but not return.
items.explanation_cz: **come back** = vrátit se. **come in / out / up** existují, ale neznamenají vrátit se.

items.en: We have to put up with the noise.
items.gap: We have to put ____ with the noise. (tolerate)
items.explanation: **put up with** = tolerate. Two particles: **up with**.
items.explanation_cz: **put up with** = snášet. Dvě částice: **up with**.

items.explanation: **turn on** = start a machine. Here: the TV.
items.explanation_cz: **turn on** = zapnout přístroj. Tady: televizi.

items.en: It's late — turn off the TV and go to bed.
items.cz: Je pozdě — vypni televizi a jdi spát.
items.gap: It's late — turn ____ the TV and go to bed. (stop)
items.explanation: **turn off** = stop a machine. Here: the TV.
items.explanation_cz: **turn off** = vypnout přístroj. Tady: televizi.

items.en: Can you pick up the kids at three?
items.gap: Can you pick ____ the kids at three? (collect)
items.explanation: **pick up** = collect someone.
items.explanation_cz: **pick up** = vyzvednout.

items.explanation: **put off** = postpone.
items.explanation_cz: **put off** = odložit.

items.explanation: **give up** = quit. Here there is no object.
items.explanation_cz: **give up** = vzdát se. Tady bez předmětu.

items.explanation: **fill in** is the British default. **fill out** is also correct.
items.explanation_cz: **fill in** je britská varianta. **fill out** je taky správně.

items.en: I found out about the change yesterday.
items.cz: O změně jsem se dozvěděl včera.
items.gap: I found ____ about the change yesterday. (discover)
items.explanation: **find out** = discover information.
items.explanation_cz: **find out** = zjistit informaci.

items.explanation: **set off** = leave. No object.
items.explanation_cz: **set off** = vyrazit. Bez předmětu.

items.en: Can you look after my bag?
items.explanation: **look after** = take care of.
items.explanation_cz: **look after** = starat se.

items.explanation: **carry on** = continue. No object here.
items.explanation_cz: **carry on** = pokračovat. Tady bez předmětu.

items.explanation: **come back** = return.
items.explanation_cz: **come back** = vrátit se.

items.en: I don't know how she puts up with all that noise.
items.gap: I don't know how she puts ____ with all that noise. (tolerate)
items.explanation: **put up with** = tolerate. Two particles: **up with**.
items.explanation_cz: **put up with** = snášet. Dvě částice: **up with**.

items.explanation: Pronouns go between verb and particle: turn **it on**, not turn on it.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno jde mezi sloveso a částici: turn **it on**, ne turn on it.

items.explanation: Pronoun: turn **it off**, not turn off it.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno: turn **it off**, ne turn off it.

items.wrong: He picked up her from the airport.
items.en: He picked her up from the airport.
accepts: He picked her up from the airport.
items.explanation: Pronoun: pick **her up**, not pick up her.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno: pick **her up**, ne pick up her.

items.explanation: Pronoun: put **it off**, not put off it.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno: put **it off**, ne put off it.

items.wrong: He gave up it last year.
items.en: He gave it up last year.
accepts: He gave it up last year.
items.explanation: Pronoun: give **it up**, not give up it.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno: give **it up**, ne give up it.

items.wrong: Please fill in it and sign at the bottom.
items.en: Please fill it in and sign at the bottom.
accepts: Please fill it in and sign at the bottom.
items.cz: Prosím vyplň to a podepiš dole.
items.gap: Please ____ and sign at the bottom.
items.explanation: Pronoun: fill **it in**, not fill in it.
items.explanation_cz: Zájmeno: fill **it in**, ne fill in it.

items.explanation: **find out** does not split: find **out** the time.
items.explanation_cz: **find out** se nerozděluje: find **out** the time.

items.explanation: **set off** = leave. Not set **on**.
items.explanation_cz: **set off** = vyrazit. Ne set **on**.

items.wrong: She looked the kids after all weekend.
items.en: She looked after the kids all weekend.
accepts: She looked after the kids all weekend.
items.explanation: **look after** never splits: look **after** the kids.
items.explanation_cz: **look after** se nerozděluje: look **after** the kids.

items.explanation: **carry on with** your work. Not carry on your work.
items.explanation_cz: **carry on with** your work. Ne carry on your work.

items.explanation: **come back** stays together: came **back** on Friday.
items.explanation_cz: **come back** drží pohromadě: came **back** on Friday.

items.wrong: I can't put it up with any longer.
items.en: I can't put up with it any longer.
accepts: I can't put up with it any longer.
I cannot put up with it any longer.
items.explanation: **put up with** never splits: put up with **it**.
items.explanation_cz: **put up with** se nerozděluje: put up with **it**.
